info.name: ProjectT API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Generated from Laravel's registered API routes. Includes all 232 API operations, example payloads, query parameters, route variables, multipart upload examples, and inherited Bearer authentication.

Set `base_url` and `token` before use. OAuth redirect/callback and simulation endpoints override inherited authentication. Empty `{}` bodies indicate endpoints that currently accept no defined payload or whose external integration payload is not yet specified in backend validation.

request.description:
Backend action: `CscsUploadController@comments`.

Returns standalone review comments and comments recorded with workflow actions.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.view

Backend action: `CscsUploadController@storeComment`.

Creates a standalone review comment without changing the batch workflow state.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.review|cscs.reconcile|cscs.approve|cscs.post

Backend action: `CscsUploadController@exceptions`.

Each exception includes severity, blocking state, parsed record values, allowed and suggested resolutions, matched account, and resolution history. `meta.exception_counts` contains total, blocking, warning, resolved, and remaining counts.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.view

Backend action: `CscsUploadController@export`.

Set collection variables `cscs_export_type` and `cscs_export_format`. Supported report pairs include `audit/pdf`, `posting/csv`, `reconciliation/pdf`, and `activity/xls` or `activity/xlsx`. Existing row, exception, preview, posting, and reconciliation CSV exports remain supported.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.export

Backend action: `CscsUploadController@postingReadiness`.

Use `data.ready` and the individual `data.checks` to populate the posting confirmation modal. This request does not change workflow state or holdings.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.view

Backend action: `CscsUploadController@preview`.

Consolidated checker payload containing named account effects, proposed new accounts, security mappings, review summary, approval timeline, and comments.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.view

request.description:
Backend action: `CscsUploadController@transactions`.

Each transaction includes UI-ready `debit_account`, `credit_account`, `quantity`, `risk`, and `resolution` objects in addition to totals, flags, and raw legs.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.view

Backend action: `CscsUploadController@transaction`.

Returns the same UI-ready transaction contract as the list: account display objects, quantity, risk, resolution, totals, flags, and raw legs.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.view

Backend action: `CscsUploadController@verificationSummary`.

Use this consolidated response for the post-posting verification screen. `data.comparison` contains approved, actual, variance, status, and matched values. Display success only when `data.verification_status` is `VERIFIED` and `data.all_checks_passed` is true.

Access middleware:
- Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate:sanctum
- Spatie\Permission\Middleware\PermissionMiddleware:cscs.view
